messages.author: 9d7c257e609d0807
messages.subject: merging sorted lists in R
parts:
Hi all,

I have k sorted numeric vectors, and I want to merge them into one
sorted vector. concatenating them and then sorting is too slow
(sorting is o(nlogn), but merging should be just o(n)). yet, writing
the regular code (which use looping), is ineffective in R. loops are
really slow. n is large (around 10^7, k is about 5). I’m looking for
an efficient R implementation for this merge. any idea/suggestion?

messages.author: 9d7c257e609d0807
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] merging sorted lists in R
parts:
x<-c(1,3,5,7,9)
y<-c(2,4,6,8)

smerge<-function(my.list) {
# naive implementation
sort(do.call(c,my.list))
};

smerge(list(x,y))
# should return 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9

#I'm looking for a more efficient implementation of smerge.
# smerge should assume that every list element is a sorted numeric vector

hope this helps
